observation.command: TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"clientId":"probe","enabled":true,"publicClient":true}' -o /tmp/probe.json -w "HTTP:%{http_code}\n" && cat /tmp/probe.json | jq 'keys'
